name: Proper LShZ-2DTM Helmet Enhanced
description_html:
A simple mod that makes LShZ-2DTM proper and functional.

The lazy BSG just left the bug that conflicts with gas mask, which is initially designed to wear the gas mask. And the tactical mount position is wrong, too.

This tiny mod just fixes these bugs and let the helmet compatible with headset and gas masks, with attributes, armor and face shield enhanced. (+1) 👇

Available at Ragman lvl.1. And the mod does not replace the original, don’t get it wrong.

The helmet you buy from Ragman is not the enhanced one.
